question: For weekly-sales data, I need an analysis of our sales performance around mid-June for the years 2018, 2019, and 2020. Specifically, calculate the percentage change in sales between the four weeks leading up to June 15 and the four weeks following June 15 for each year.
sql:
-- Calculate total pre and post sales, and percentage change for each year
WITH weekly_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        calendar_year,
        week_date,
        SUM(sales) AS weekly_sales
    FROM cleaned_weekly_sales
    WHERE calendar_year IN (2018, 2019, 2020)
    GROUP BY calendar_year, week_date
),
period_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        calendar_year,
        SUM(CASE 
            WHEN calendar_year = 2018 AND week_date IN ('2018-05-21', '2018-05-28', '2018-06-04', '2018-06-11') THEN weekly_sales
            WHEN calendar_year = 2019 AND week_date IN ('2019-05-20', '2019-05-27', '2019-06-03', '2019-06-10') THEN weekly_sales
            WHEN calendar_year = 2020 AND week_date IN ('2020-05-18', '2020-05-25', '2020-06-01', '2020-06-08') THEN weekly_sales
            ELSE 0
        END) AS pre_sales,
        SUM(CASE 
            WHEN calendar_year = 2018 AND week_date IN ('2018-06-18', '2018-06-25', '2018-07-02', '2018-07-09') THEN weekly_sales
            WHEN calendar_year = 2019 AND week_date IN ('2019-06-17', '2019-06-24', '2019-07-01', '2019-07-08') THEN weekly_sales
            WHEN calendar_year = 2020 AND week_date IN ('2020-06-22', '2020-06-29', '2020-07-06', '2020-07-13') THEN weekly_sales
            ELSE 0
        END) AS post_sales
    FROM weekly_totals
    GROUP BY calendar_year
)
SELECT 
    calendar_year,
    pre_sales,
    post_sales,
    ROUND(1.0 * (post_sales - pre_sales) / pre_sales * 100, 2) AS pct_change
FROM period_sales
ORDER BY calendar_year

-- Calculate total pre and post sales, and percentage change for each year
WITH weekly_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        calendar_year,
        week_date,
        SUM(sales) AS weekly_sales
    FROM cleaned_weekly_sales
    WHERE calendar_year IN (2018, 2019, 2020)
    GROUP BY calendar_year, week_date
),
period_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        calendar_year,
        SUM(CASE 
            WHEN calendar_year = 2018 AND week_date IN ('2018-05-21', '2018-05-28', '2018-06-04', '2018-06-11') THEN weekly_sales
            WHEN calendar_year = 2019 AND week_date IN ('2019-05-20', '2019-05-27', '2019-06-03', '2019-06-10') THEN weekly_sales
            WHEN calendar_year = 2020 AND week_date IN ('2020-05-18', '2020-05-25', '2020-06-01', '2020-06-08') THEN weekly_sales
            ELSE 0
        END) AS pre_sales,
        SUM(CASE 
            WHEN calendar_year = 2018 AND week_date IN ('2018-06-18', '2018-06-25', '2018-07-02', '2018-07-09') THEN weekly_sales
            WHEN calendar_year = 2019 AND week_date IN ('2019-06-17', '2019-06-24', '2019-07-01', '2019-07-08') THEN weekly_sales
            WHEN calendar_year = 2020 AND week_date IN ('2020-06-22', '2020-06-29', '2020-07-06', '2020-07-13') THEN weekly_sales
            ELSE 0
        END) AS post_sales
    FROM weekly_totals
    GROUP BY calendar_year
)
SELECT 
    calendar_year,
    pre_sales,
    post_sales,
    ROUND(1.0 * (post_sales - pre_sales) / pre_sales * 100, 2) AS pct_change

ORDER BY calendar_year
